modes.name: Auto
modes.note: Metered and set by the city, so the meter should read close to this. App bookings add a small convenience fee.

modes.name: Bike taxi
modes.note: App pricing, which changes with demand. Bike taxis have been stopped and restarted repeatedly in Karnataka, so one may not be bookable at all.

modes.name: Cab
modes.note: App pricing for the cheapest class of car. It rises steeply when it's busy or raining, so treat the higher figure as the likely one at those times.

sources.what: Auto fare: ₹30 for the first 2 km, ₹15 per km after, one and a half times between 10 p.m. and 5 a.m.
sources.licence: News report of the Bengaluru transport department's revision; not an official source
PathOS estimate from typical app fares in Bengaluru; the operators publish no fare table
